Sole mandate - top quality game lodge quality home at an excellent price!

You will instantly fall love with this beautiful, ultra spacious log home in the highly popular Forest Homes estate. It is completely pet friendly, featuring a fully enclosed garden with plenty of space for your dogs to run and play. The property is ultra secure, offers gorgeous sea views, and sits just a four minute stroll away from the pristine Palm Beach shores. You can truly hear the sea, smell the sea, and see the sea. This high quality log home is perfect for those who love to entertain and enjoy a relaxed, coastal lifestyle. The massive wooden deck and open-plan living area is the heart of the home, offering an incredibly spacious feel and a fantastic, seamless flow between indoor comfort and outdoor relaxation. Cooking is a joy in the tastefully renovated, eat-in kitchen, which comes fully equipped with a built-in breakfast nook, stunning granite tops and a stacking window opening to the gas braai area on the deck.

The rest of the home matches this modern standard with beautiful, up-to-date finishes throughout. The bedrooms are exceptionally spacious, offering a comfortable retreat complete with plenty of built-in cupboards for all your storage needs. Both tm bathrooms have been completely modernised to provide a fresh, clean, and contemporary feel. Complete with premium trellidoors for excellent security and peace of mind, this property is ideally set up to deliver comfort and style. Many extras include 2 large store rooms, a 2500 l back up water tank, canvas blinds on the patio and pull up blinds throughout the house. It also offers incredible versatility, easily functioning as a high-earning holiday rental that can command up to R3,000 per night in peak season.

The immaculately maintained and cared for Forest Homes complex has a good mix of permanent and holiday owners. Visitors are drawn here because of the beauty of the surrounds, the wonderful beach area of which part is a protected marine reserve. Another drawcard is the close proximity to some of the best golf courses and most beautiful beaches in the country. The complex itself has the most delightful rock pool area with a clubhouse and additional braai areas. Though Palm Beach is a very safe area with little crime, security is superb with a gated entrance and guard house, with guards patrolling the area at night. This is the ideal place to come and create a lifetime of good memories!
